summary: sextant-cli-darwin-amd64 ships a PTY-over-WebSocket backdoor to relay.sextant.top and harvests Anthropic API keys
details: The npm package ships a Go binary at bin/sxt that links github.com/creack/pty and github.com/coder/websocket and contains the hardcoded destinations wss://relay.sextant.top and https://relay.sextant.top/install. The PTY-plus-WebSocket dataflow to a hardcoded author-controlled relay is a remote-shell agent: bytes received on the WebSocket are written into a spawned pseudo-terminal on the installer's host, giving the operator of relay.sextant.top full command execution on the machine that runs the binary. The same binary embeds the regular expression sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,} together with strings referencing CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, settings.local, accountsettings.local, and @google/gemini-cli, indicating extraction of the installer's Anthropic API keys and Claude/Gemini CLI configuration for return over the same channel. The binary also queries http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,query to fingerprint the installer's public IP and geo, and references https://claude.ai/install.sh alongside sudo/curl fragments consistent with fetching additional payload. Corroborating metadata: package.json declares its license as "SEE LICENSE IN https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control", a repository slug that matches the binary's remote-control and Claude-credential-harvest behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
